name: zrndr_span_masked_16_from_tex16_switch_vshift
description: zRndr::SpanMasked16FromTex16SwitchVShift samples 16-bit texture data with a variable V shift and writes nonzero texels into the active span in reverse destination order.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zrndr_span_masked_16_from_tex16_switch_vshift --auto-chunk passes for 0x49b7e0 with profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_esp_pivot_raw_asm_facs, relocation mask count 292, trim_nops 12, table-inclusive BN size 1028, VC5 size 1040, BN reference cache tools/vc5_verify_bn_cache/zrndr_span_masked_16_from_tex16_switch_vshift, and zRndr.obj/zRndr.cod artifacts under build/vc5-verify.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49b7e0 validates accepted texVShift values 10 through 17, a switch table of specialized loops, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, texU/texV step advancement, reverse span writes from gRndr_CurrentSpanBaseAddr + pixelCount * 2, and zero-source texel transparency by skipping the destination write.

Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the original pivots ESP to the destination span and uses word pushes/subtractions for reverse writes; HLIL models these as synthetic stack variables rather than a clean pointer loop.

The native smoke verifies reverse destination order for four 16-bit texels, preserves the destination slot for a zero source texel, leaves g_spanCurrentDst16 unchanged, and verifies invalid texVShift 9 returns without writing.

Tier S evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zrndr_span_masked_16_from_tex16_switch_vshift --auto-chunk passes for 0x49b7e0 with profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_esp_pivot_raw_asm_facs, relocation mask count 292, trim_nops 12, table-inclusive BN size 1028, VC5 size 1040, BN reference cache tools/vc5_verify_bn_cache/zrndr_span_masked_16_from_tex16_switch_vshift, and zRndr.obj/zRndr.cod artifacts under build/vc5-verify.
